s00016.summary: A stranger rides into a dry creek bed while a young woman with a shotgun watches.
He asks after Cullen Pike; she denies knowing him and demands his business.
She approaches; he gives his name Jedediah and her guard slips slightly.
Odalys says Cullen was her father, buried under the second pier since Tuesday.
Jedediah asks who killed him; Odalys levels the shotgun and blames the man who sent him.

pd_dollhouse_5.summary: Rank stops by; Helmer lets him in and they chat about the evening's wine.
Nora asks about his scientific investigation; Rank hints at certainty about his death.
They joke about fancy-dress costumes while Rank keeps his own costume secret.

s01095.summary: Sheriff Augustine stands with widow Abigail at the grave; she answers his offers curtly.
She hangs his hat on the cross and refuses the paper; he buries it instead.
Jeremiah takes his mother's hand and they watch the cross until dusk.

s01033.summary: In a stalled funicular, August calmly cows bruised Silas about the briefcase.
Scrapes sound on the roof as the car sways.
Zofia drops through the roof hatch with an ice axe and demands they open the briefcase.
The case is empty; a handprint outside the window shows something else is there, and the car drops.

s01060.summary: Halcyon, Teodoro and Chioma banter over bland food, yield numbers, and Teodoro's worrying pump.
Nervous intern Nadeem joins them and learns their roles and the beige food.
Teodoro adopts Nadeem as the listener of his pump stories.
Commander Stone welcomes Nadeem dryly, and the group eats as Earth turns above.
